projects.title: DRIP, Financial Risk Intelligence Platform
projects.description:
Built a production platform in Python and SQL scoring 100 monitored assets and $124B+ in exposure across code safety, drawdown, volatility, concentration, and liquidity, surfacing high-risk entities for live users.
Automated exposure tracking and threshold alerting in Python, replacing manual screening with real-time Tableau dashboards that flag breaches as they occur rather than surfacing them at period end review.

projects.title: HeartAI Platform, Clinical Data Engineering Pipeline
projects.description:
Delivered an analysis-ready dataset to a clinical AI team by building a dbt and Snowflake pipeline with medallion architecture, consolidating fragmented PostgreSQL records on a daily batch schedule.
Implemented dbt tests and documentation standards across all layers with Git version control, catching schema and null-value issues in staging before they reached the models downstream teams relied on.

projects.title: Order Fulfillment SLA Monitor & Seller Scorecard
projects.description:
Traced a 1-point drop in customer review scores to seller handoff delay and carrier transit variance by analyzing 99K marketplace orders in SQL, ruling out order volume as the driver teams had assumed.
Replaced monthly aggregate review with a weekly Power BI scorecard flagging SLA breaches, with drill-through from breach to individual order so operations could act on specific sellers instead of trends.
